_doc: glass_gem: faceted gems get facets (a = facets per texture unit); atlases with gold bezels, corks or labels mask them out by the art (wear 1); the x-ray glasses (a dark plastic frame round a painted lens) are plastic; flat glass panes and bottles (their reflections are painted in the art; a flat pane has no highlight to sharpen, a tighter lobe only shrinks the painted sheen) are left unchanged (strength 0)
